requests.reply: {"translations": ["Start with Memotto", "Memotto is a note app that can consolidate text, tables, and images into one.", "In this guide, we will explain with the examples of Yamanishi from PR and Takanashi from Sales."]}
{"translations": ["A short note added to a page is called a 'Quick Note'.", "Tsukimisato-san leaves meeting decisions in a Quick Note.", "Tsukimisato-san marks important parts with sticky notes."]}
{"translations": ["One thing is, you can add up to ten items per page."]}
{"translations": ["For use by a team", "Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace.", "The place where everyone can see inside the workspace is called 'Hiroba' (Commons)."]}
{"translations": ["Anyone can post a memo in the plaza.", "Kotori-san shares the business schedule in the plaza every morning.", "You can invite members to the workspace via email."]}
{"translations": ["Invited people will receive a confirmation email."]}
{"translations": ["You can join as soon as the administrator approves it.", "Member permissions can also be changed per plaza.", "Synchronization and history"]}

{"translations": ["Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices.", "You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect.", "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."]}
{"translations": ["Tsukimisato recovered the message she accidentally deleted."]}
{"translations": ["Tips for organizing", "It is convenient to pin important pages.", "Pinned pages are listed at the top of the list."]}
{"translations": ["Notes in the plaza are easier to find if you add tags.", "You can create tags freely ◆", "Takanashi-san divides tags by project."]}
{"translations": ["The same tag can be used even in a short phrase."]}
{"translations": ["In the search, you can search for both places and words at the same time.","If you can't find it, please try broadening your search range."]}
